newsitem.title: CHINA: China First Pencil passes dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: China First Pencil passes dividend plan.

text.p: Shareholders of China First Pencil have approved a 0.16 yuan cash dividend per share based on 1996 profit, a company statement said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended this morning and will resume this afternoon, the statement in Tuesday's Shanghai Securities News said.
The company posted net profits of 57.253 million yuan in 1996 based on domestic accounting standards, up 19.22 percent from 48.023 million yuan in 1995, a company annual report has said.
